metadata.condition: uncorrected; one owned queued request at a time; GameInputSvc stopped

limitations: CompletionObservedQpc is observation time, not exact kernel completion time; up to 20 ms wait/poll granularity.
Maximum 1024 requests; reaching the cap ends recording early. No added resubmission pacing.
Native API/close calls have no hard timeout; the budget is checked between calls.
CancelIoEx targets only this owned request. Unresolved storage/handles stay allocated until dedicated process exit.
At most one request outstanding; this is a test client, not a GameInput service-rate measurement.
Only successful exact 24-byte replies are read. Equal payloads exclude the packet word only during later analysis.
Device identity requires separate loaded-driver/device-stack debugger verification.
Phase cues and operator reports do not prove complete physical input delivery. Raw input is not collected here.
No first-success comparison baseline. Adjacent success comparisons exclude failed/cancelled rows.
Full-payload equality excluding the packet word does not decode every private field.
Submission and observed-completion windows are separate; pending requests can cross phase boundaries.
Endpoint service checks are not continuous monitoring; controller configuration was not rehashed in this recording.
Initial device lifetime/population and correction status require separate debugger evidence; no game workload was measured.
